summary: NeOnc Technologies filed an 8-K reporting the entry into a fourth Securities Purchase Agreement to issue up to 406,694 shares of common stock at $7.20 per share along with warrants exercisable at $9.00, continuing a series of prior unregistered direct offerings. The company is acting as issuer raising capital under existing terms; investors include institutional and other purchasers. The filing does not involve a merger, tender offer, going-private, spin-off, or other special-situation event. Rather, it is a routine disclosure of an equity financing agreement. No structural premium, board recommendation, or regulatory clock is triggered. Watch for potential dilution from warrant exercises and completion of the offering by the April 30, 2026 termination date.
